excluded_paper_components: The source experiment selects several pairs from CRSP dividend-reinvested total-return histories; this sample selects one pair from three synthetic close series without dividends.

The paper reports one-dollar long and one-dollar short legs. This engine fixes each leg at 100 units of quote currency using signal-close prices and fills at next opening; later returns and corporate actions do not reproduce the paper's return accounting.
Orders for both legs are submitted together but fill independently on each symbol's next event; this engine does not guarantee atomic pair execution.

A final exit is signaled one session before the end of the trading interval to permit next-open execution. Delisting, staggered monthly portfolios and the original market results are outside this implementation.

steps.paper_rule: Rank formation-period pairs by summed squared distance of normalized prices.
steps.runtime_rule: Select the formation pair minimizing squared distance between normalized closing-price paths.

steps.paper_rule: Open on a spread exceeding two formation standard deviations and unwind at the next price crossing.
steps.runtime_rule: Open at a two-standard-deviation divergence and close when the normalized spread crosses zero.
